name: pickup_archive_read_record
description: Reads one pickup archive record, clears primary pickup state on the first record, spawns the pickup from record fields, and restores the respawn delay.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent pickup.cpp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e840 validates first-record clearing, zeroing PickupType::nameSuffixMax across all 40 entries, SpawnAt argument mapping from the 0x30-byte record, and respawn-delay restoration. The native archive-read smoke covers the first-record reset path separately from a valid record spawn to avoid stale world-child ownership from other spawn tests.
